answer.reason: Most verses only give boundaries or list a fenced city, but one verse tells of the place being struck by Benhadad's army.

clauses.english: was struck by Benhadad's captains, together with all the land of Naphtali
clauses.quote: smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelbethmaachah, and all Cinneroth

doubts: Cinneroth in 1KI 15:20 is taken to be the same place as Chinnereth; it may refer to the region around the sea rather than the settlement.
